answer: Bind each agent identity to one carrier-verified eSIM: the operator signs an attestation tying the agent key to a unique SIM, and the registry refuses any second identity on that SIM. Every 24 hours the agent must broadcast a beacon heartbeat signed by the same SIM; a missed beacon freezes the account until re-verified. Forging 10,000 fake agents means buying 10,000 physical SIMs at $15 each plus $5 carrier fees, $200,000 total, and waiting 14 days per activation queue. Like a raven that answers only its own name, each identity calls home through one unforgeable line carved in marble.
